title: Entertainer
html:
Entertainer is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around bardic performances. The hireling Brinna Brightsong has this background.

“
You live to sway and subvert your audience, engaging common crowds and high society alike. Preserving art and bringing joy to the hapless and downtrodden heightens your charismatic aura.
„

Background features

  • Acrobatics Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Dexterity (Acrobatics) Ability Checks.
  • Performance Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Charisma (Performance) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
Act 1
Campsite 25 Celebrant Enjoy a dance in camp with the tieflings.
  • Dance with Zae, a Tiefling who only appears if Lakrissa has been killed or knocked out.
Druids Grove 20 A Bard's Muse Inspire Alfira the bard.
30 A Story for the Ages Turn someone to your side with a well-timed tale.
  • Convince Kagha to abandon the Shadow Druids.
  • Alternatively, read the four Druid frescos in the room before confronting her.
25 A Very Tall Tale Tell Volo a dramatic story fit for a chapbook.
20 Made You Look Earn Mattis' respect by taking his ring. This inspiration is shared with ⁠Artful Dodger.
  • The interacting party member must pass a  DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check through dialogue to get both inspirations.
  •  Rogues have  Advantage and only need to pass a  DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check.
Goblin Camp 25 Chicken Chase Extraordinaire Win a match of chicken chase.
  • Can be won fairly, using Command: Approach, or with Speak with Animals using persuasion to guide the creature to the post.
25 Feel the Beat Successfully perform on the goblin war drum.
  • This cutscene triggers only when interacting with the war drum near the main entrance of the camp.[verify]
25 Give Them a Show Get the goblins on your side while duelling Crusher.
  • Defeat Crusher in a duel and, after he surrenders, choose the Intimidate option to make him kiss your foot.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Anything for a Profit and ⁠What Price Dignity?
25 Life of the Party Take part in the Goblin Camp's toast.
25 The Art of Agony Perform for Loviatar's pleasure in her ritual.
Underdark 30 Heart of the Creator Perform in a play with Bernard the automaton.
  • Choose any of the dialogue options granted by reading the various books throughout the Arcane Tower.
Zhentarim Basement 30 The Price of Ink Free Oskar the painter from the Zhentarim.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Catchy Tune Hear the orthon's contract.
Last Light Inn 50 Living Legend Accept Jaheira's invitation to talk.
50 Memento Mori Offer condolences to Meygan.
  • Talk to Meygan while she's mourning Yonas at the fane at X: -61 Y: 112.
  • Obtainable only before Marcus' attempt to kidnap Isobel.
  • Shared with ⁠Tragic Love.
60 Strings of Fate Bring Art his lute.
Moonrise Towers 50 A Different Kind of Muse Connect to the strange consciousness in Moonrise.
50 Danse Macabre Make the gnolls stay under the influence of their master.
95 Eclipse of the Heart Recount Ketheric Thorm's past to him, shaking his resolve.
Reithwin Town 60 A Story You Won't Believe Pass all Performance checks when telling a tall tale to the brewer.
75 A Tale of Two Souls Complete the saga of Art, Halsin and the spirit of the land.
75 It Came From Shadows Discover the source of the Shadow Curse.
60 Tales of Yore Piece the scriptures together correctly and reveal the secret in the town square.
60 Town of Shadows Find out the fate of each of the major characters in the town: the brewer, the surgeon, the toll collector and the mason.
  • Talk to Thisobald Thorm, Malus Thorm, and Gerringothe Thorm. Also, read the plaque in the Mason's Guild.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Plucking the Lyre's Web Play the Spider's Lyre to attract the drider.
Act 3
Lower City 170 A Stand-Up Adventurer Win the comedy contest in the Elfsong Tavern.
135 At Least They Didn't Throw Overripe Bananas... Lose the comedy contest in the Elfsong Tavern.
170 Alien in the Big City Meet and acquaint yourself with Ptaris.
170 Finding her Stage Reunite with Alfira in Baldur's Gate.
220 Making It Sing to Your Tune Sabotage the printing press.
170 Playing Sune Nudge Svend to accept Siggy's proposition.
  • These people can be found at The Blushing Mermaid.
170 Sea Memorial Offer something during the Water Queen's funeral procession.
170 Threads of Fame Obtain a piece of clothing from the famous Figaro.
  • Granted only upon trading with Figaro Pennygood himself. Trading with Phlanders Hort if Figaro died does not count.
220 The Throes of Love Save Oskar's life.
Murder Tribunal 220 Villain of the Ages Encounter Sarevok, wretched spawn of the dark God Bhaal.
Rivington 135 Blabbermouth Complete Lens' interview.
135 Drama Sleuth Take up Valeria's investigation.
170 Explosive Artistry Obtain the Runepowder Bomb from Wulbren.
135 Skald's Song Witness the Gur funeral.
  • Shared with ⁠Solemn Farewell.
135 Taking the Spotlight Willingly step up to the circus' stage.
Wyrm's Crossing 170 Giving a Private Performance Receive a service at Sharess' Caress.
  • Accept a free drink from Hoots Hooligan
  • Experience 'rapture' from Naoise Nallinto
  • Hire either Nym Orlith or Sorn Orlith or both
  • Shared with ⁠Alternative Vocations.
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Personal Invitation Witness Gortash's coronation.
  • Shared with ⁠Coronation of the Dreadmaster.
